name: Rope Net Trap OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-09: Equal Exchange - Skymetal Hoard
description: This trap is a net weaved from rope laid out beneath the jungle underbrush with mechanisms attached to some nearby trees; when triggered, it cases the target in the net and suspends them indefinitely.
disable: DC 14 Thievery to cut the triggering length of rope

offensiveAbilities.name: Ensnare
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature steps on top of where the trap is located

Effect The triggering creature is caught in the rope net. The target must attempt a DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw save or be Immobilized in the net and suspended in the air until they Escape from the net.
